articles.title: Delhi NCR AQI hits 350, 79% residents identify biggest cause of pollution
articles.summary: Construction activity, garbage burning and dust from roads have emerged as key concerns, according to a new survey by community platform LocalCircles. The survey received 20,761 responses from residents of Delhi, Noida, Ghaziabad, Gurugram and Faridabad. Nearly eight in 10 respondents identified construction activity as a major reason for rising pollution.

articles.summary: 80 as a key level to watch The rupee appreciated 31 paise to 94. 86 against the US dollar in early trade on Thursday, supported by the ongoing impact of the Reserve Bank of India's structural forex interventions and liquidity-tightening measures. Market participants attributed the rupee's continued appreciation to central bank intervention and the unwinding of long dollar positions.

articles.title: New Odisha Governor Braj Mohan Ram says will get more votes for BJP
articles.summary: BHUBANESWAR: Newly -appointed Odisha Governor Braj Mohan Ram’s statement that he would work to strengthen the BJP’s organisation in the state has stirred up a hornet’s nest. In an interview with a news agency in Ranchi, Ram said he would work to further activate the BJP’s Scheduled Caste (SC) Morcha in Odisha after assuming office as Governor.

articles.title: Assam Government provides Rs 5 lakh assistance to Himashree Boro's family
articles.summary: The Assam government has provided a one-time financial assistance of Rs 5 lakh to the family of Himashree Boro, the young dancer who was found dead beside a railway track in Andhra Pradesh last week. Dimoria MLA Tapan Das handed over the cheque to the family on behalf of the state government under the Chief Minister’s Relief Fund.

articles.title: Have Indian Sports Federations Ruined their sports? Update 20 in Athletics in India
articles.summary: If anyone has followed the history of Indian sports, most will know about a golden streak in Indian hockey from 1928 to 1940: four straight Olympic golds before the World Wars intervened, and the 1940 and 1944 Olympics were not held. Indian hockey returned with two more golds in London in 1948 and Helsinki in 1952.

articles.title: How the balance of power in auto JVs is shifting towards India
articles.summary: Stellantis India recently said it will use Tata Motors’ vehicle architecture and product technology to build products for global markets, the latest sign that JV rules are being rewritten.
